zh.label: 最新版本
zh.title: 更清晰的标注图标与即时提示
changes: 重新设计高亮笔与马赛克图标，统一工具栏的尺寸、线条和颜色风格
文字识别使用扫描框图标，鼠标悬浮时显示“文字识别”，并同步更新繁体中文和英文提示
截图工具栏的悬浮提示延迟缩短至 16 毫秒；移开鼠标、点击工具或关闭选区时及时消失
提示框会根据窗口边缘调整位置，不拦截鼠标操作
提供 Apple Silicon 与 Intel 通用版本，应用和 DMG 通过 Apple 公证，Sparkle 更新包带有签名

en.label: Latest
en.title: Clearer annotation icons and faster tooltips
changes: Redesigned highlighter and mosaic icons with consistent toolbar sizing, strokes, and colors.
Text recognition uses a scan-frame icon and a clear hover label, with updated Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English text.
Selection toolbar tooltips now use a 16 ms delay and dismiss when the pointer leaves, a tool is clicked, or the selection closes.
Tooltips adjust near window edges and let pointer input pass through.
Includes Apple Silicon and Intel support, an Apple-notarized app and DMG, and a signed Sparkle update package.
